items.title: Why A&O Hostels Is Buying Europe’s Empty Buildings
items.summary: Most hospitality groups are shedding real estate. a&o is picking it up at distressed prices — a contrarian move that works up until the deals, or the lenders, run dry.

items.title: Klook Co-Founder Bets AI Can Finally Fix Travel Experiences Discovery
items.summary: Klook has no grand OTA ambitions, at least for now. Its bigger bet is that AI can smooth out the messiness of experiences booking and help it deepen its lead in the category while pulling travelers into adjacent trip spend.

items.title: How Ken Chenault Became Travel’s Most Consequential Non-Operator
items.summary: One person connects the Amex GBT take-private, Airbnb’s board, a $10.75 billion travel loyalty startup, and Berkshire Hathaway’s governance committee.

items.title: Apple’s Rebuilt Siri Opens New Doors for Travel Apps
items.summary: Apple's rebuilt Siri is not booking trips. But it is getting better at understanding the messy context around them.

items.title: New $750 Fee Lets Travelers Jump the U.S. Visa Line
items.summary: One immigration attorney calls the latest U.S. travel fee a step toward a two-tiered system: one path for the rich, another for everyone else.

items.title: Skyscanner CEO on Agentic Booking and the Future of Flight Metasearch
items.summary: Given Skyscanner's leading global footprint in flights, it isn't hard to envision an LLM extracting it from Trip.com Group to accelerate building a travel vertical.

items.title: Alaska Bets Starlink Will Boost Customer Loyalty as It Scraps Basic Economy Perks
items.summary: Alaska is doing away with earning points on basic economy seats, but it thinks the installation of Starlink across its fleet will funnel more customer loyalty.
